description: Phase 3: context-mode time-aware DeepSeek pricing — patch the unminified pricing.js fallback (staged + idempotent patch script), prove native-cost pass-through, skip the fragile minified-bundle patch.

phases.task: Verify the phase-3 v2 strategy against the REAL installed files and lock the spec. STRATEGY v2 (already decided, verify feasibility only): patch ONLY pricing.js with a time-aware DeepSeek override (computeCostUsd gains an optional third param tsMs; deepseek ids get peak/off-peak rates from a self-contained inline pure-UTC engine + 2026 CN holiday table; no ts => static peak = backward compatible); do NOT patch the minified bundle (native-cost pass-through from phases 1-2 already makes the common rows time-aware); prove the pass-through with a probe script. Report: whether each of the 3 facts holds, any surprises (e.g. bundle export shape for importing), and a final VERDICT line: `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: BLOCK <reason>`.

Check whether the specs-ok phase verified all three facts and concluded VERDICT: PASS. If it did, verdict pass. If it blocked for a fixable reason (e.g. a wrong assumption about file shapes), describe the fix in the reason. Respond ONLY with JSON: {"verdict":"pass"|"block","reason":"..."}.

Keep lookupPrice's signature unchanged (returns the static peak Price). Do NOT touch nativeOrComputed's behavior. Also copy the installed build/session/model-prices.json verbatim to stage/context-mode/build/session/model-prices.json. Do NOT modify anything under ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules — stage only. Run `node --check stage/context-mode/build/session/pricing.js`.

Write tests/ctxmode-pricing.test.ts (node:test + node:assert/strict, zero deps, plain .ts like tests/rates.test.ts) importing from '../stage/context-mode/build/session/pricing.js' (ESM import; the file uses `import ... with { type: "json" }`). Write scripts/patch-ctxmode.sh (bash, set -euo pipefail, zero deps beyond node/coreutils) implementing phase-3 install policy from docs/phase-specs/phase-3.md: default mode `apply` copies stage/context-mode/build/session/pricing.js over ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/context-mode/build/session/pricing.js — first making a timestamped backup pricing.js.pre-ds-pricing.<epoch>.bak when the installed file differs from staged; IDEMPOTENT: if sha256 of installed == staged, print 'ALREADY PATCHED' and exit 1 (documented convention — caller checks exit codes); if installed was modified by someone else since our backup, still back up then overwrite. Print the installed context-mode package version (node -p "require('.../package.json').version") in apply/check output so upgrade detection is easy. Also write scripts/probe-native-pass.mjs: zero-dep Node ESM probe that (a) imports the installed session-extract.bundle.mjs IF possible; if the bundle cannot be imported cleanly, fall back to the unminified build/session/extract.js+analytics.js pipeline and SAY SO in the output; (b) finds the most recent session file under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/**/*.jsonl (newest mtime), runs extraction over it, counts rows whose model_id starts with 'deepseek': rows WITH a numeric native_cost_usd vs rows that fell back to catalog computation; (c) writes docs/evidence/phase3-native-pass.json with {probeTime, source: 'bundle'|'build', sessionFile, totals, samples: up to 5 rows}; (d) prints a 10-line summary. Run `bash -n scripts/patch-ctxmode.sh && node --check scripts/probe-native-pass.mjs`.
